text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Blue, blue, blue~~!!
The calming color of blue~~!!"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
What's wrong?! My heart's been beating like crazy
for a while now!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I've been staring at blue things trying to calm down a bit,
but it's not working at all!
I'm all fired up and itching to go—
choice_data_list: I think that's proof you're in good condition.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: In good shape...? Ah, that's it! Right now, I just want to run so badly!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Then let's go with passionate red!
All riiight, I'm heading out with all my might☆"
